question: In December 2021, which neighbouring country conferred the Prime Minister of India with its highest civilian award, the Order of the Druk Gyalpo?
solution:
The correct answer is** __Bhutan__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Ruler of Bhutan, **His Highness **Jigme Khesar Namgyel Wangchuck**, presented its most elevated non military personnel grant, the Request for the Druk Gyalpo, on Top state leader, Shri Narendra Modi on the event of the country's Public Day.
 
• Th**e Druk Gyalpo** is the head of condition of the Realm of Bhutan.
 
• The ongoing sovereign of Bhutan is Jigme Khesar Namgyel Wangchuck, the **fifth Druk Gyalpo.**
 
• He climbed the privileged position on first November 2008 after his dad,** Jigme Singye Wangchuck** renounced the privileged position in support of himself.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Myanmar**

 
 
• The Order of the Union of Myanmar is the highest civilian decoration bestowed by the government of Myanmar.
 
 
 
• **Nepal**
 
 
• Nepal Ratna Man Padavi Order of the Jewel of Nepal is the highest civilian award of Nepal.
 
 
 
• **Sri Lanka**
 
 
• Sri Lankabhimanya is the highest national honours of Sri Lanka awarded by the President of Sri Lanka on behalf of the Government, falling alongside the National Hero of Sri Lanka. 
 
• **Narasimhan Ram **is the first Indian national to win the 'Sri Lanka Rathna' award.
